title: The protective effects of curcumin on metabolic syndrome and its components: In-silico analysis for genes, transcription factors, and microRNAs involved.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过数据库和对接分析姜黄素对代谢综合征的基因、转录因子和miRNA调控网络，虽涉及PPARG等TF-DNA相关靶点，但核心是药物机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法以数据库和简单对接为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟深度。
abstract: BACKGROUND: We aimed to identify the molecular mechanisms behind curcumin's therapeutic benefits for metabolic syndrome (MetS) and its components. METHODS: The Comparative Toxicogenomics Database, MIENTURNET, Metascape, GeneMania, and Cytoscape software were critical analytic tools. RESULTS: Curcumin may have therapeutic effects on MetS and its components via the following genes: NOS3, IL6, INS, and ADIPOQ, particularly PPARG. Curcumin has higher docking scores than other genes with INS and PPARG (docking scores: -8.3 and -5.8, respectively). Physical interactions (56%) were found to be the most prevalent for dyslipidemia, co-expression for hypertension, obesity, T2DM, and MetS. "Galanin receptor pathway", "lipid particles composition", "IL-18 signaling pathway", "response to extracellular stimulus", and "insulin resistance" were listed in the first of the key pathways for MetS, dyslipidemia, hypertension, obesity, and diabetes, respectively. The protein-protein interaction enrichment analysis study also identified "vitamin B12 metabolism," "folate metabolism," and "selenium micronutrient network" as three major molecular pathways linked to MetS targeted by curcumin. PPARG was the key transcription factor that regulated practically all curcumin-targeted genes linked to MetS and its components. Curcumin targeted hsa-miR-155-5p, which has been linked to T2DM, hypertension, and MetS, as well as hsa-miR-130b-3p and hsa-miR-22-3p, which have been linked to dyslipidemia and obesity, respectively. In silico, sponges that regulated hsa-miR-155-5p were developed and evaluated. Curcumin, MetS, and its components have been found to target adipocytes, cardiac myocytes, smooth muscle, the liver, and pancreas. Curcumin's physicochemical properties and pharmacokinetics are closely connected with its therapeutic advantages in MetS and its components due to its high gastrointestinal absorption, drug-likeness, water solubility, and lipophilic nature. Curcumin is a CYP1A9 and CYP3A4 inhibitor. Although curcumin has a low bioavailability, it can be synthesized and administered to increase its pharmacokinetic features. CONCLUSIONS: Curcumin needs to undergo therapeutic optimization and further study into its pharmacological structure before it can be used to treat MetS and its components.
abstract_zh: 背景：我们旨在确定姜黄素对代谢综合征（MetS）及其组分发挥治疗作用的分子机制。方法：比较毒物基因组学数据库、MIENTURNET、Metascape、GeneMania 和 Cytoscape 软件是关键的分析工具。结果：姜黄素可能通过以下基因对 MetS 及其组分产生治疗作用：NOS3、IL6、INS 和 ADIPOQ，尤其是 PPARG。姜黄素与 INS 和 PPARG 的对接分数高于其他基因（对接分数分别为 -8.3 和 -5.8）。物理相互作用（56%）被发现是血脂异常中最普遍的，而共表达则见于高血压、肥胖、T2DM 和 MetS。“甘丙肽受体通路”、“脂质颗粒组成”、“IL-18 信号通路”、“对外部刺激的反应”和“胰岛素抵抗”分别被列为 MetS、血脂异常、高血压、肥胖和糖尿病的关键通路之首。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用富集分析研究还确定了“维生素 B12 代谢”、“叶酸代谢”和“硒微量营养素网络”是姜黄素靶向的与 MetS 相关的三个主要分子通路。PPARG 是调控几乎所有与 MetS 及其组分相关的姜黄素靶向基因的关键转录因子。姜黄素靶向 hsa-miR-155-5p，该 miRNA 与 T2DM、高血压和 MetS 相关，以及 hsa-miR-130b-3p 和 hsa-miR-22-3p，分别与血脂异常和肥胖相关。在计算机模拟中，开发并评估了调控 hsa-miR-155-5p 的海绵体。姜黄素、MetS 及其组分被发现靶向脂肪细胞、心肌细胞、平滑肌、肝脏和胰腺。姜黄素的理化性质和药代动力学与其在 MetS 及其组分中的治疗优势密切相关，这归因于其高胃肠道吸收、类药性、水溶性和亲脂性。姜黄素是 CYP1A9 和 CYP3A4 抑制剂。尽管姜黄素生物利用度低，但可通过合成和给药来提高其药代动力学特征。结论：姜黄素在用于治疗 MetS 及其组分之前，需要经过治疗优化并对其药理结构进行进一步研究。
